thread.title: Glenview State Bank Trust DEPT. Raises Holdings in Apple Inc. (AAPL)

author: ABMN Staff
title: Glenview State Bank Trust DEPT. Raises Holdings in Apple Inc. (AAPL)

organizations.name: glenview state bank trust dept. raises holdings

text:
Glenview State Bank Trust DEPT. grew its stake in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 1.3% during the second quarter, according to the company in its most recent disclosure with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The institutional investor owned 78,140 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after purchasing an additional 969 shares during the quarter. Apple accounts for 6.7% of Glenview State Bank Trust DEPT.’s investment portfolio, making the stock its biggest position. Glenview State Bank Trust DEPT.’s holdings in Apple were worth $14,464,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).
Several other institutional investors and hedge funds also recently modified their holdings of AAPL. Delphi Private Advisors LLC acquired a new position in shares of Apple in the second quarter worth about $120,000. Quattro Financial Advisors LLC acquired a new position in shares of Apple in the first quarter worth about $133,000. CX Institutional acquired a new position in shares of Apple in the second quarter worth about $135,000. Spectrum Financial Alliance Ltd LLC acquired a new position in shares of Apple in the first quarter worth about $138,000. Finally, Macroview Investment Management LLC lifted its stake in shares of Apple by 220.3% in the first quarter. Macroview Investment Management LLC now owns 900 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $151,000 after acquiring an additional 619 shares in the last quarter. Institutional investors own 58.35% of the company’s stock.
